# SEAK, Inc.

> SEAK, Inc. is a leading provider of expert witness training, professional development seminars, and litigation support resources for legal professionals.

SEAK specializes in comprehensive expert witness education through live seminars, workshops, and reference materials. The organization hosts flagship annual conferences and specialized training programs covering deposition skills, trial testimony, report writing, and practice management, with offerings both in-person and via live Zoom workshops.

## Key Topics

- Expert Witness Training
- Deposition Skills
- Trial Testimony
- Expert Witness Report Writing
- Practice Building
- Professional Development
- Litigation Support
- Continuing Education
- Karen Cerbarano
- SEAK Expert Witness Directory
- Live Workshops
- Clearwater Beach
- Naples, Florida
- Expert Witness Fees
- Expert Witness Liability Insurance
